findings_to_judge.finding: Asana's live production API now licenses AI Studio as a per-user seat with three tiers - ai_studio_plus, ai_studio_pro and ai_studio_max - of which 'Max' appears nowhere on Asana's public pricing page or help docs, and every AI run is tagged with a credit_source of 'paid' or 'free'; this is the recurring, seat-priced AI line management pre-committed on the Q1 call to quantify for the first time on THIS call.
findings_to_judge.source_date: 2026-09-03 (retrieved; the endpoint was announced 2026-07-02 per Asana's changelog)

findings_to_judge.finding: Asana retired 7,368,000 shares for $44.985 million in the single quarter ended 2026-04-30 - roughly 3% of shares outstanding in three months at an average of about $6.11 - leaving $154.5 million authorised, against a float already shrunk by Moskovitz's ~27% stake and short interest above 22%.

monday.com's Q2 print on 2026-08-10 - the first category datapoint issued after Asana last spoke, covering a quarter that overlaps two thirds of Asana's - reported NDR of 109%, 'gross retention is also at historical highs' and 'we are still seeing a double-digit seat growth year-over-year in enterprise', directly contradicting the seat-destruction frame that caps Asana's multiple.

Asana enters this print with no dedicated chief accounting officer: CAO/PAO Veronica Sosa resigned on 2026-07-13 effective 2026-08-07, and on 2026-08-26 - six days before the print - the board handed the principal accounting officer role to CFO Aziz Megji, himself appointed only in March 2026 after CFO Sonalee Parekh resigned in February 2026, making three finance-leadership changes in six months.

After a 16.8% twenty-day run-up that contemporaneous coverage attributes to short covering and sector rotation rather than company news, ASAN trades roughly 10% ABOVE the 15-analyst average price target of $9.27 with a consensus 'Hold', and consensus FY27 revenue of $860.8m sits dead centre of the company's own $855.5-863.5m guide - so there is no estimate slack to beat into.
